statement: Visa Inc.'s effective tax rate in fiscal 2024 differs from fiscal 2023 primarily due to a tax position taken across jurisdictions and a $223 million tax benefit from concluded audits.
Visa Inc. recorded a $142 million tax benefit in fiscal 2023 from the reassessment of an uncertain tax position due to new information from an ongoing tax examination.
Walmart Inc.'s net sales benefited from the timing of certain seasonal events and positive fluctuations in currency exchange rates of $0.4 billion for the three months ended April 30, 2024.
Walmart Inc.'s gross profit rate increased 32 basis points for the three months ended April 30, 2024, compared to the same period in the previous fiscal year.
Walmart Inc.'s operating expenses as a percentage of net sales decreased 47 basis points for the three months ended April 30, 2024, compared to the same period in the previous fiscal year.
Walmart Inc.'s operating income increased $0.4 billion for the three months ended April 30, 2024, compared to the same period in the previous fiscal year.
Oracle Corporation's total services revenues decreased 3% in FY2024 compared to FY2023.
The decrease in Oracle's services revenues was due to a decrease in revenues in each of the primary services offerings, excluding the effects of currency rate fluctuations.
Vertex Pharmaceuticals Incorporated's selling, general and administrative expenses increased by 42% in the second quarter and first half of 2024 compared to the same periods in 2023.

The increase in selling, general and administrative expenses was primarily due to increased investments for global therapy launches and near-term product preparations, as well as compensation expenses from cash-settled unvested Alpine equity awards.
Vistra Corp.'s Texas segment represents results from electricity generation operations in the ERCOT market, excluding assets now part of the Sunset or Asset Closure segments.
Vistra Corp.'s East segment aggregates electricity generation operations in the PJM, ISO-NE, and NYISO markets under the Eastern Interconnection due to similar economic characteristics.

Vistra Corp.'s Sunset segment includes generation plants with announced retirement dates after December 31, 2024, and unrealized gains/losses from commodity risk management are allocated to this segment.
Labcorp Holdings Inc.'s Dx revenues increased 5.9% for the six months ended June 30, 2024, compared to the same period in 2023.
The Dx revenue growth was driven by organic revenue of 3.3% and acquisitions, net of divestitures, of 2.7% for the six months ended June 30, 2024.
NIKE Direct revenues decreased 4% in FY2025 Q1 due to digital sales declines of 15%, partially offset by comparable store sales growth of 8% and the addition of new stores.
NIKE Direct digital sales declined 20% in FY2025 Q1.
M&T Bank Corporation's total investment securities available for sale had a current yield of 4.30% at December 31, 2024, up from 2.66% at December 31, 2023.
The weighted-average duration of M&T Bank's investment securities portfolio increased from 1.3 years at December 31, 2023 to 2.6 years at December 31, 2024.
The Procter & Gamble Company's operating income increased $30 million, or 1%, to $5.8 billion for FY2025 Q1.
The increase in operating income was driven by a higher operating margin, which more than offset the decrease in net sales.
Interest expense for FY2025 Q1 was $238 million, an increase of $13 million compared to the prior year period.
Other non-operating income/(expense) decreased by $686 million to $(554) million for FY2025 Q1.
The effective income tax rate for FY2025 Q1 was 22.4%, up from 21.5% in the prior year period.
The 22.4% effective tax rate increase was primarily due to a 300 basis-point charge from foreign currency translation losses in Argentina.

NRG Energy, Inc. closed on the sale of its 100% ownership in the Airtron business unit on September 16, 2024, resulting in net proceeds of $480 million after working capital and other adjustments of $20 million.
NRG Energy, Inc. recorded a gain of $204 million from the sale of the Airtron business unit within the West/Services/Other region of operations.
J.B. Hunt Transport Services, Inc.'s FMS segment revenue decreased 1% to $910 million in 2024 from $918 million in 2023.
J.B. Hunt Transport Services, Inc.'s JBT segment revenue decreased 11% to $702 million in 2024 from $789 million in 2023.
BORGWARNER INC's PowerDrive Systems segment net sales decreased $212 million, or 13%, for the nine months ended September 30, 2024, compared to the same period in 2023.

The PowerDrive Systems segment's decrease in net sales was primarily due to approximately $243 million of reduced volume, mix, and net new business from decreased demand for light vehicle Foundational products, partially offset by $27 million in customer recoveries.

The PowerDrive Systems segment's Segment Adjusted Operating Loss increased due to lower sales, higher R&D investments, and impacts related to the Eldor acquisition, partially offset by restructuring savings and customer volume related recoveries.
The PowerDrive Systems segment's net sales decrease was partially offset by $21 million in additional sales from acquisitions during the nine months ended September 30, 2024.

The PowerDrive Systems segment's net sales decrease included a $17 million year-over-year impact from foreign currency fluctuations, primarily due to the weakening Chinese Renminbi relative to the U.S. Dollar.
The acquisition of Eldor contributed $9 million of additional sales year-over-year for BORGWARNER INC.
EXPAND ENERGY Corp recognized $23 million of separation and other termination costs during the Current Period related to one-time termination benefits for certain employees.
Nasdaq, Inc. manages, operates, and provides products and services in three business segments: Capital Access Platforms, Financial Technology, and Market Services.
The Capital Access Platforms segment includes Data & Listing Services, Index, and Workflow & Insights.
As of September 30, 2024, Nasdaq had 5,225 companies listed across its U.S., Nasdaq Nordic, Nasdaq Baltic, and Nasdaq First North exchanges.
Phillips 66’s realized refining margins for the year ended December 31, 2024, were $6,014 million worldwide.
The realized refining margins per barrel for Phillips 66 in 2024 were $8.84 worldwide.

Warner Bros. Discovery, Inc.'s Distribution revenue increased 1% for the three and six months ended June 30, 2024, primarily due to a 7% increase in subscribers from Max launches in Latin America and Europe, partially offset by domestic linear wholesale subscriber declines.

Warner Bros. Discovery, Inc.'s Advertising revenue increased 99% for the three months ended June 30, 2024, and 86% for the six months ended June 30, 2024, primarily due to higher Max domestic engagement and ad-lite subscriber growth.

Warner Bros. Discovery, Inc.'s Global ARPU increased 4% for the three and six months ended June 30, 2024, driven by domestic ad-lite subscriber growth and a subscriber mix shift from linear wholesale, partially offset by growth in lower ARPU international markets.

Nucor Corporation's capital expenditures in 2024 include significant projects such as a sheet mill under construction in West Virginia, a sheet mill expansion in Indiana, a rebar micro mill under construction in North Carolina, and the construction of two manufacturing locations to expand Nucor Towers & Structures.
Nucor acquired Rytec for approximately $565.0 million during the third quarter of 2024, contributing to increased cash used in investing activities in the first nine months of 2024 compared to 2023.
Chubb Limited's Global Reinsurance segment reported a 32.2% increase in net premiums written in FY2024 compared to FY2023.
Chubb Limited's Global Reinsurance segment achieved a combined ratio of 85.9 in FY2024.
PPG Industries, Inc.'s Traffic Solutions segment organic sales were flat in FY2024 Q3 due to higher sales volumes in the U.S. being offset by lower selling prices.
Verisk Analytics, Inc. acquired 100 percent of the stock of Nasdaq subsidiary Simplitium Limited for a cash purchase price of $20.0 million on April 2, 2025.
The Simplitium acquisition will provide Verisk clients with access to 300+ third-party models, enhancing risk insights globally.
The Simplitium acquisition supports Verisk's expansion in Europe and its goal of helping insurers and claims service providers leverage holistic data and technology tools.
Fifth Third Bancorp's effective income tax rate was 21.2% for the three months ended March 31, 2025.
Fifth Third Bancorp's effective income tax rate was 21.1% for the three months ended March 31, 2024.
Fifth Third Bancorp's income tax expense was $138 million for the three months ended March 31, 2025.
Fifth Third Bancorp's income tax expense was $138 million for the three months ended March 31, 2024.
Assurant, Inc.'s Global Lifestyle net earned premiums, fees and other income increased $74.6 million, or 4%, to $2.18 billion for Second Quarter 2024 compared to Second Quarter 2023.
The increase in Global Lifestyle net earned premiums, fees and other income was primarily driven by Connected Living from mobile growth.

Deere & Company's performance in FY2024 was adversely affected by decreases in demand for agricultural equipment due to downturns in the agricultural industry and other factors, which varied by market.
In FY2024, unfavorable market conditions led to lower sales volumes, higher sales discounts, higher receivable write-offs, and a higher provision for credit losses for Deere & Company.
Deere & Company expects certain unfavorable market conditions, including high unemployment, high interest rates, and cautious consumer spending, to persist into FY2025.
Deere & Company's construction and forestry segments have been materially impacted by decreases in construction activity and housing starts due to adverse economic conditions.

Sustained negative U.S. fiscal and economic conditions, including market volatility and interest rate changes, could continue to impact Deere & Company's market liquidity, funding access, and earnings.

American Water Works Company, Inc.'s West Virginia subsidiary received an $18 million annualized increase in water and wastewater system revenues from a base rate adjustment approved by the West Virginia Public Service Commission on February 23, 2024.

The West Virginia base rate adjustment was based on an authorized return on equity of 9.80%, an authorized rate base of $886 million, a common equity ratio of 50.10%, and a long-term debt ratio of 49.90% as of February 2024.
The West Virginia base rate adjustment was driven primarily by $220 million of related water and wastewater system capital investments made since the completion of the previous rate case.
Vulcan Materials Company's Aggregates segment gross profit increased 6% to $528.5 million in FY2024 Q2.
Aggregates segment gross profit margin expanded 120 basis points in FY2024 Q2.
Cash gross profit per ton for Aggregates segment improved 12% to $10.92 per ton in FY2024 Q2.
Aggregates shipments decreased 5% year-over-year in FY2024 Q2 due to significant rainfall in key markets like Texas and the Southeast.
Price growth in the Aggregates segment was strong in FY2024 Q2, with freight-adjusted selling prices increasing 12.2% year-over-year.
Non-aggregates segments gross profit was $19.9 million lower in FY2024 Q2 compared to the prior year.
Globe Life Inc.'s net investment income increased at a compound annual growth rate of 6% over the three years ending 2024.
The growth in net investment income was primarily due to a 3% growth in average invested assets and higher interest rates.

Cboe Global Markets, Inc. was the largest European stock exchange throughout the third quarter, with a share of continuous trading volume of 32.4%, up more than four percentage points from the previous quarter.
Tapestry, Inc.'s revenue in Europe grew 19% compared to the previous year.
Starbucks Corporation's North America total net revenues for the first quarter of fiscal 2025 decreased $49 million, or 1%, compared to the first quarter of fiscal 2024.
The decrease in North America net revenues was partially offset by net new company-operated store growth of 5%, or 527 stores, over the past 12 months ($230 million).
Lennox International Inc.'s revenue increased 15% in the third quarter of 2024 compared to the same period in 2023.
The revenue growth included a 6% increase in sales volumes from the AES acquisition.
Jack Henry & Associates, Inc.'s private and public cloud offerings increased over 11% in the first quarter of fiscal 2025.
Semiconductor equipment customers continued to make strategic investments in new capacity and new technology transitions during the first nine months of fiscal 2024.

Foundry and logic customers’ spending decreased in the three and nine months ended July 28, 2024 compared to the same periods in the prior year driven primarily by lower customer investments in leading-edge manufacturing technologies.

Memory customers’ spending in the three and nine months ended July 28, 2024 was higher as compared to the same periods in the prior year primarily due to increased investments in DRAM technology transitions.
PACCAR Inc's used trucks held for sale, net of impairments, were $387.0 million at June 30, 2024 and $309.8 million at December 31, 2023.
PACCAR Inc recognized losses on used trucks, excluding repossessions, of $13.6 million in the second quarter of 2024 compared to gains of $19.1 million in the second quarter of 2023.
PACCAR Inc's used truck losses related to repossessions were $1.8 million for the second quarter of 2024 and not significant for the second quarter of 2023.

Paycom Software, Inc.'s recurring and other revenues increased for the year ended December 31, 2024 compared to the year ended December 31, 2023 due to new clients, increased sales to existing clients, and pricing strategies, partially offset by client attrition.

Paycom Software, Inc. earned $29 million in interest on funds held for clients for the year ended December 31, 2024, up approximately 2% year-over-year on an average daily balance of approximately $2.5 billion.
Bristol Myers Squibb's U.S. revenues increased 9% during the third quarter of 2024 compared to the same period in 2023.
The increase in U.S. revenues was partially offset by a decrease in average U.S. net selling prices of 1% year-to-date compared to the same period a year ago.
WEC Energy Group, Inc. issued 1,030,674 shares of common stock under the EDA during the year ended December 31, 2024, receiving net proceeds of $98.3 million.
Arch Capital Group Ltd.'s insurance segment contributed $120 million of underwriting income in the 2024 third quarter.
The insurance segment’s 2024 third quarter results include two months of activity related to the MCE Acquisition completed on August 1, 2024.
Excluding the MCE Acquisition, insurance growth was in the mid-single digits.
Motorola Solutions, Inc. acquired Noggin, a global provider of critical event management software, for $91 million net of cash acquired subsequent to the FY2024 Q2 period.
Motorola Solutions, Inc. acquired a vehicle location and management solutions provider for $132 million net of cash acquired subsequent to the FY2024 Q2 period.
Motorola Solutions, Inc. acquired Silent Sentinel, a provider of specialized long-range cameras, for $37 million net of cash acquired prior to the FY2024 Q2 period.
CME Group Inc. declared a regular quarterly dividend of $1.25 per share on February 6, 2025, payable on March 26, 2025, to shareholders of record on March 7, 2025.
The first quarter dividend payment under the regular quarterly dividend program will total approximately $455.0 million, assuming no changes in the number of shares outstanding.
CME Group Inc. also declared an additional, annual variable dividend of $5.80 per share on December 5, 2024, paid on January 16, 2025, to shareholders of record on December 27, 2024.
PTC Inc. recognizes revenue for the license portion of on-premises subscription contracts up front when licenses are delivered to customers, typically on the start date.
PTC Inc. recognizes revenue on the support portion of on-premises subscription contracts and stand-alone support contracts ratably over the term.
PTC Inc. converts existing support contracts to on-premises subscriptions, shifting recognition to up-front license revenue in the conversion period.
